title: Guest Folios Control Schedule: Late Charge and Dispute Windows, Desk Adjustment Limits and Settlement Settings
content:
Six control figures of each Ashbury brand govern a Guest Folio after the stay: the calendar days after check-out within which the hotel may still post charges incurred during the stay, the total of adjustments and benefit credits guest services may post on one folio (larger corrections are referred to the hotel), the calendar days after check-out within which a billing correction may be requested, whether guest services may reopen a settled folio to correct it within the dispute window, whether the remaining balance is charged automatically to the card on file at check-out, and whether credits are refunded only to the card the folio was settled to.

## Control schedule

| Brand | Late charge posting window | Desk adjustment limit per folio | Dispute window after check-out | Settled folio may be reopened within the dispute window | Balance charged to card on file at check-out | Credits refunded only to the card settled to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | 3 calendar days | $100.00 | 60 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | 3 calendar days | $150.00 | 60 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Hotel | 5 calendar days | $250.00 | 90 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Grand | 5 calendar days | $350.00 | 90 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 7 calendar days | $400.00 | 90 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Reserve | 7 calendar days | $600.00 | 120 calendar days | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

- The two windows are stated in calendar days after check-out: the late charge posting window is the shorter one at every brand, from 3 calendar days at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites to 7 calendar days at Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve; the dispute window runs from 60 calendar days up to 120 calendar days at Ashbury Reserve.
- The desk adjustment limit is a total for the folio, not a per-line figure: it is the most guest services may post on one folio in adjustments and benefit credits together.
- The last three settings read "Yes" at every brand.
